September is the pre-heating and pre-winter reliability window: generator evaluations, panel upgrades, service calls, second-home winterization, lighting and shade automation projects, and 24/7 emergency positioning all peak at once. Resort and mountain shops (Steamboat, Glenwood Springs, Durango, Bayfield) sell high-end residential and automation work where qualification and routing matter more than raw lead volume. Owner-led field work with phone/form intake is the norm; pitch reliable capture while electricians are on jobs, not replacing technical judgment. Skip patterns: lead-broker style "electrical network" sites (Duft/Colorado Electrical Network), generic SEO-location pages, and larger multi-tech firms that dilute the owner-led fit (R&A Enterprises included with a size caveat).
